# Full Lotus Health

> Acupuncture and Chinese medicine clinic in Burbank, CA, run by one licensed acupuncturist and focused on skin: microneedling, nanoneedling, and cosmetic acupuncture. Practitioner: Roozbeh Ghobadpour, L.Ac. (California acupuncture license #17220, NCCAOM Board-Certified Diplomate), in practice since 2016. "The calmest hour of your week."

## Quick facts
- Address: 2116 N Glenoaks Blvd, Ste 3, Burbank, CA 91504
- Phone or text: (818) 253-9307 · Email: info@fulllotushealth.com
- Serves Burbank, Glendale, Toluca Lake, North Hollywood, and Studio City
- Self-pay clinic. Book online: https://www.fulllotushealth.com/book-online
- Google reviews: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJJVOw4haVwoARK0UW-MPNiMw
- In California, microneedling may be performed by physicians and licensed acupuncturists.

## Skin and beauty treatments
- [Microneedling](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/medical-microneedling-session): $500, 90 min. Collagen induction therapy with custom Chinese herbal serums and red light therapy. For fine lines, acne scars, uneven texture, and thinning hair.
- [Nanoneedling](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/facial-nano-needling): $350, 60 min. A gentle surface treatment with custom herbal serums and red light therapy. No downtime. For glow, hydration, and sensitive skin.
- [Cosmetic Acupuncture](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/full-lotus-lift): $250, 60 min. Facial acupuncture at tension-releasing and lifting points, combined with constitutional body points. Red light therapy included.

## Acupuncture and herbal medicine
- [Acupuncture: Initial Treatment](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/acupuncture-initial-treatment): $180, 60 min. A detailed intake, a treatment plan, and your first acupuncture treatment.
- [Acupuncture: Repeat Treatment](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/acupuncture-repeat-treatment): $120, 45 min. Acupuncture treatment following your plan from the initial intake.
- Also offered: Chinese herbal medicine (including for skin conditions), cupping, moxibustion, therapeutic massage.

## Online consultations
- [Initial Consultation (Online)](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/initial-consultation-online): $180, 60 min. A comprehensive online consultation with herbal prescriptions and nutritional guidance.
- [Repeat Consultation (Online)](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/repeat-consultation-online): $180, 45 min. A follow-up session to review progress and adjust your wellness plan.

## Tea ceremonies
- [Gong Fu Tea Ceremony](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/gong-fu-tea-ceremony): $55, 60 min. Premium tea prepared with precision, for mindfulness and deep relaxation.
- [Private Gong Fu Tea Ceremony](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/private-gong-fu-tea-ceremony): $250. A private session for up to five guests, with loose-leaf tea prepared with precision and mindfulness.
- [Bowl Tea Ceremony](https://www.fulllotushealth.com/service-page/bowl-tea-ceremony): $35. A small-group ceremony of silent, mindful tea drinking.

## About the practitioner
Roozbeh Ghobadpour, L.Ac., holds an M.A. in Traditional Chinese Medicine from Yo San University (2015) and a B.A. from UCLA. He has over 10 years of clinical experience, is continuing advanced study in Chinese medicine dermatology, and is the Head Chinese Medicine Writer for Global Tea Hut magazine.
